GLOWLINE – Neon Run & Gun
=========================

START
1. Start Steam and log in (needed for online multiplayer).
2. Double-click Glowline.exe.
   If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC":
   "More info" -> "Run anyway" (the game is not signed).
3. Play the TUTORIAL first.

PLAY WITH A FRIEND (over Steam)
- Both players: Steam is running, Glowline.exe is started.
- Player 1: MULTIPLAYER -> choose a mode (CO-OP or VERSUS) -> CREATE LOBBY.
  A code appears (for example QX7K2M) -> COPY it and send it to your friend.
- Player 2: MULTIPLAYER -> type the code or press PASTE -> JOIN.
- Player 2: GET READY, then player 1 presses START.
Your Steam name is used as your player name.
Note: Steam shows "Spacewar" while you play. That is expected: it is Valve's test app,
which the game uses until it has its own Steam release.
Invites from the Steam friends list only work if the game is already running for your friend.
The code is the most reliable way.

Keep steam_appid.txt next to Glowline.exe.

CONTROLS
Keyboard/mouse: A/D move, Space jump (on walls: wall jump), S while running to slide,
mouse to aim, left click to shoot, Shift to dash, S+Shift in the air for a ground slam, Esc to pause.
Controller: left stick move, A jump, right stick aim, RT shoot, B dash,
stick down + B in the air to slam, Start to pause.
Menus: D-pad or stick to move, A to confirm, B to go back.
